title: A Foundational Analysis of Local Functional Calculus
content: The chain rule for generalized conformable derivatives has been incorrectly stated in the literature, neglecting the dependence of the scaling function on the inner function. In this paper we introduce the local functional calculus, a unifying framework for local derivative and integral operators built on an arbitrary positive continuous function. For the general functional derivative we prove the fundamental properties: linearity, product rule, continuity, Rolle’s theorem, the mean value theorem, and the fundamental theorem of calculus via the corresponding integral operator. Our main result is the correct chain rule, which includes an extra factor depending on the inner function and thereby rectifies the error in earlier works. As a special case we develop the local Euler calculus with the exponential kernel, yielding explicit derivative and integral formulas for elementary functions. The local functional calculus provides a solid, self-contained foundation for a wide class of local operators, extending far beyond the traditional fractional setting.
